name: The Anomalous Acorn
source:
You are a squirrel, living a simple life: scurry around trees, avoid predators and people who want to take photographs and find food. Yet this acorn you've just discovered is different from the ones you usually eat: it seems to demand to be eaten, yet you think you should dispose of it.

Which of the two do you choose?

[From [url=https://writerofweird.itch.io/the-anomalous]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一只松鼠，过着简单的生活：在树林里奔跑，躲避掠食者和想要拍照和寻找食物的人。然而你刚刚发现的这个橡子和你平时吃的不一样：它似乎需要被吃掉，但你却认为你应该把它处理掉。

这两者你选哪一个？

[来自[url=https://writerofweird.itch.io/the-anomalous]Itch.io[/url]]
